fields.title: M5 and LCP evidence gaps
fields.finding: No qualified M5/PIPD humid-service membrane allowable found. Accessible LCP chart is relative, not absolute WVTR.
fields.proposed_fix: Obtain absolute gauge/rate/condition/areal-mass records for LCP and relevant loaded wet-strength data for M5 before numeric credit.

claim: No qualified M5/PIPD humid-service membrane allowable found. Accessible LCP chart is relative, not absolute WVTR. | M5 and LCP evidence gaps
numerical_scope: Source NFI carried without a new independent check
qualification: Its WVTR 0.08 assumption, desiccant capacity, kinetics and unweighed hardware are not an assembled seven-day demonstration. The 059 pond values were not reproduced; both proposed pond routes remain surrogates. Bulk drying is not complete drying.
